title: Normalization pushforward ring stalk and its local-ring algebra structure
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $
u:X^
u	o X$ be its componentwise reduced normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. For $x\in X$, define $C_x=(
u_*\mathcal O_{X^
u})_x$, the ring stalk at $x$ of the direct image of the structure sheaf. Equip $C_x$ with its canonical $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-algebra structure induced by taking the stalk at $x$ of the structure-sheaf morphism $\mathcal O_X	o
u_*\mathcal O_{X^
u}$.
